༄༅/ /rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i sbyin sreg dbang gi lcags kyu rnam par spel ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang rje btsun rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i sbyin sreg dbang gi lcags kyu rnam par spel ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang rje btsun rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun ma'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i gang zag gis dbang gi sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la de'i dbus nas shar du sor gsum dor ba'i sar thab kyi dbus kyi mtshan ma byas la/ khru phyed kyi tshad tsam gyi srad bus me nas brtsams te dbang ldan gyi bar du g.yas skor du bskor/ de'i phyir kha khyer dang mu ran la sor bzhi bzhis bskor la/ so so'i rtse thig gis sbrel te zla gam gyi dbyibs su bya/ de'i phyir stegs bu gru bzhi pa dang grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje spyi dang mthun par bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad dmar po la re khā dkar bo'i nang du padma 'dab ma brgyad dang / mu ran lcags kyu'i phreng ba bri/ dbus su lha mo'i mtshan ma utpal dmar po bri/ yang na tshon spung dmar po/ yang na 'bru dmar po'i tshom bu bya/ de steng shing dmar ro skyur gyis zla gam dbyibs mtho gang tsam mam/ yang na srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam pos dbyibs gong bzhin brtsigs/ thab kyi shar du stan nang tshang can dang / de'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs rnams sta gon bya/ bdag gi g.yas nas yam shing mar/ me tog dmar po'am 'bras dmar po/ mngar gsum gyi zas mchog til/ so ba/ nas/ gro/ dur ba/ ku sha rnams bsham/ bdag gi g.yon nas chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang / bku bag can gyi zlum gtor dmar po gnyis bsham/ gzhan yang ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang / me sbar ba'i rtswa skam po srog chags med pa sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ phyi dro'i dus su rgyan gos dmar pos brgyan la/

chags shing 'dun pa'i bsam pas gnas yo/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yang khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra nai wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhuṣpe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shapta'i bar dang / mthar rdo rje snying khar bzung / dril bu rgyun dkrol dang / oṃ badzra gaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pradzñā pa ra mi ta nā da swa bhā wā/ badzra dharmā hrī da ya ni santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis brkyang te rtse sbyar chu bzhi'i rgya/ khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gi thur du blugs pa bdug pa'i'o/ /mthe bong gyen bsgrengs mar me'i ste/

/thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gi /de nyid gyen bkan zhal zas so/ /se gol gtogs pa rol mo'i sgra/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri pad nyi la bla ma 'od dpag med longs spyod rdzogs sku dmar po mnyam gzhag can gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma dang sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa la bdag dang sems can rnams 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis ku ru kuller gsal ba'i thugs khar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po de las 'od 'phros pas bla ma dbu la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kulle mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ

na ma ku ru kulle bhyaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ku ru kulle/ zhes sogs sngon 'gro'i/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs shapta'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces lan gcig brjod/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ zhes sngags brjod pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su paṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kulle sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis utpala'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing / g.yas 'og mas khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu dang /

g.yon 'og mas utpa la'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi thod pa lngas dbu brgyan zhing / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yas pa'i brang ba gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu'i 'od kor gyis yongs su mdzes shing snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i utpal dmar mo'i lte bar nyi ma la hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rig byed kyi phug nas rje btsun ma ku ru kulle la sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu brgyan par bsam/ de la rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bsam zhing thal mo sbyar la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/

/ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /pus ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ yi ge sngags rnams kyis ni gtso bos mchod/ /'dod chags chen por rjes chags pas/ /gsang chen sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ yi ge sngags rnams rnam par spangs/ /sgra dang thig le sems kyang med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid/ /ces pas bstod/ bdud rtsi snod dang bcas pa/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum mar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang / bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ shar du bhrūṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rakta/ nub tu dzriṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bhrūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor āṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub dzriṃ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis a ā i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ

g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga po lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar ba'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing bkol bas rlangs pa gyen la song bas oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang / lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis ka dang / gdan bzhi las/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la/ /srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkri/ /gung mo dang ni mthe'u rtse sbyar/ /khro bo gnyis ni mnan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myong / bde bas mnyes par bsam/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ mar me'i phreng ba lta bu las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi stobs sogs kyi yon tan thams cad dang / skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim par bsams la/

oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥswāhā/ zhes ma yengs par tsandan dmar po'i phreng ba ming med kyi steng nas drangs shing bgrang la phreng 'khor gcig sogs kyi mthar bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ man ngag thob na rang byin brlabs kyi dmigs pa bsgom pa ni/ lus gnad bcos te rlung ro bsal la/ rang nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kuller gsal ba'i lus kyi nang phru ma phus btab pa dmar seng nge ba'i dbus lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar la rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar ser/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar smug g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po ste gsum ka gro sog 'bring po tsam dbu ma la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba dbu ma'i mas snar aṃ dmar po dbu can gyi shad lta bu'i klad skor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar ser mgo gyen du bstan pa/ nang 'khor 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsam ste/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa sha ya/ phyi skor drug cu rtsa bzhi la mdun nas g.yon bskor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ a ā/ a ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ rnams mgo gyen du bstan pa/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa rnams mgo gyen du bstan pa/ phyi nang gi yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar ser/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir bhrūṃ/ aṃ/ dzriṃ/ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir/ laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ rnams kha dog sngon po mgo thur du bstan pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i dbus su aṃ rtsa 'dab bcu drug la mdun nas g.yon skor du/

a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ oṃ āḥ rnams kha dog dmar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbus dbu ma'i yas snar haṃ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ klad skor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis la mdun nas g.yon skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ a āḥ g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta rnams kha dog dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ snying kha'i hūm̐ gi steng dbu ma'i nang du hrīḥdamar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ bshang sgor rlung / sum mdor me/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyis sbyor ba lan gsum byas mtha' ma la bsdam pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar te lte ba'i aṃ la bsnun pas aṃ las me shin tu cha phra ba/ g.yas ro ma nas song / lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi yig 'bru rnams kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song / snying kha'i yig 'bru rnams kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ hrīḥlas 'od dmar po 'phros pas/ g.yas kyi me dang lhan cig tu ro ma nas song / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ me ro ma'i yas sna nas 'thon/ thod pa'i nang du mdun nas g.yon skor gyi rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga nas song / phyag g.yas pas mda' ltong sbyar ba'i mda'i ltong nas zhugs/ rim pas song ste/ mde'u utpal dmar po kha bye nas 'od zer phyir song nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems sems can thams cad ku ru kuller gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas pa nas zhugs/ spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams kyi 'khor lo'i khams kyi dwangs ma rnams bsdus nas/ rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga nas 'thon/ rang gi utpala'i mde'u nang du zhugs rna ba g.yas pa nas song / ltag pa nas g.yas su bskor te/ spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang 'grogs nas g.yon rkyang ma nas thur du babs pas mgrin pa dang /

snying ga'i 'khor lo rgyas par byas nas song lte ba'i aṃ la thigs pa gcig phog pas me cher 'bar/ dbu ma'i mas sna kha bye nas/ dbu ma nas mar song / snying ga'i hūm̐ dang hrīḥmagrin pa'i aṃ rnams kyi snyigs ma bsregs/ dbu ma'i yas sna kha bye ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas haṃ las byang sems dkar po babs pas/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i yi ge gsum gsos btab lte ba'i gong sor bzhi tsam du 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad pas 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du 'dus/ zhes brjod cing gsal btab la/ rlung bum pa can ci thub bzung mi thub na rlung dal bus btang zhing ngal gsos/ rlung bzung ba'i tshe 'bar 'dzag la yid drag tu gtad cing / mthar byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gsang gnas yan chad du khyab cing gang ba las brten nas byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bzhi thob cing / yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes te/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dri ma med pa las byung ba'i dam pa'i bde ba bla na med pas rang gi lus dang snod bcud thams cad khyab par mos te/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad kyis stong pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dang bral bas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang tsam dbyer mi phyed pa'i bde stong dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhes brjod cing gsol btab la/ shes pa khong lhod kyis klod nas mnyam par bzhag ldang bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ zhes brjod/ 'dir rje btsun ma'i sku bsgom zhing sngags bzlas pa ni bum dbang gi lam rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi gsal btab nas 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad pa ni gsang dbang gi lam/

bde ba'i nyams myong la sems gtad pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ gang la thog ma sogs kyi tshig don la mnyam par 'jog pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin no/ /spor lde sbar la/ thal mo'i bar du bzung nas/ ngag tu/ oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis thab la bskor/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la raṃ/ zhes pa'i thab kyi nang du me sbar/ oṃ agne ye dzwa la raṃ/ zhes dang / mar dgang blug gsum tsam gyis me gso/ bar 'dir me pra brtag ste/ yang dag pa sbyor ba las byung ba rtogs sla ba'i phyir tshigs bcad du brjod na/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rdo rje dang / /bum pa padma lcags kyu dang / /sku gsum pa dang g.yas su 'khyil/ /rtse gcig pa ste dbyibs mchog yin/ /rtse gnyis rtse gsum 'bring dang tha/ /snum dang gtsang dang dbang po'i gzhu/ /dbang po sbas dang ser dang dkar/ /baiḍūrya rnams mdog bzang yin/ /dang ba'i sgra dang bung ba'i sgra/ /zab cing snyan pa'i sgra ni bzang / /mdor na yid du 'ong ba yi/ /dbyibs dang dri dang mdog rnams bzang / /me stag 'phro dang du ba mang / /rim gyis 'bar zhing me lce chad/ /myur du 'bar zhing gzi brjid chung / /tsha zhing dmar nag drag tu 'bar/ /rtse gsum gzhib ma 'dra ba dang / /ba glang mgo 'dra dri mi zhim/ /mdor na yid du mi 'ong ba/ /mtshan ngan rnams kyang brtag par bya/ /zhi ba dkar dang rgyas pa ser/ /dbang la dmar po drag la gnag /'di ni rang rang rtag tu bzang / /'jam po gsum la 'jam po yin/ /rtags rnams shes par bshad pa ste/ /tha ma'i las la ngan pa bsngags/ /rang rang rtags dang mi mthun na/ /bgegs dang bcas pa shes byas te/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sogs pa'i/ /khro bos bgegs rnams zhi bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar me pra brtag ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing nang mchod nas gtor/ de nas thab dang yo byad rnams la nang mchod gtor te/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/

zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dang bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dbang gi las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra ni wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhūu pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta'i bar so so'i phyag rgya dang / de nas mchod yon phyag rgya kho nas bsreg rdzas rnams la oṃ shrī swāhā/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ thab khung stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las dbang gi thab khung zla gaṃ dmar po rgyar khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran la lcags kyu'i phreng bas bskor ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med par bsam/ de'i nang du paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi khor yug rdo rje'i rwa dang drwa ba steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ bsrung 'khor gyi nang me'i dbus su raṃ las bgrang phreng raṃ gyis mtshan pa las/ me lha dmar po rwa skyes la chibs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas dbyug gu dang g.yon bgrang 'phreng 'dzin pa/ drang srong gi cha lugs can gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ lag pa gnyis kyis mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag

mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya sna ba'i drung du g.yab cing / hūm̐ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa ma dzāḥzhes dang / rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam ste/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig oṃ badzra satwa a/ zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo/ /de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ bsam/ dgang blug gi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ bsam ste oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing / mar blug gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ mthar/ oṃ agna ye dī pyā dī pyā/ bi shuddhe ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya/ bā ha nā ya swāhā/

zhes brjod cing dgang blug kha sbyar la 'bul/ de lta bu lan gsum bya/ mthar/ oṃ agna ye sa pā ri wā ra nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs chu bzhi la rigs 'gre mtshan sngags de nyid sngon 'gro'i puṣpe pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin spos nas rol mo'i bar la rigs 'gre sbyar mtshan sngags mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis phul/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /me lha'i mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la/ yam shing la sogs pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams/ rim pa bzhin lag pa g.yon du bzung la g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ agna ye bo dhi bṛkṣa ye swāhā/ zhes pa gcig dang oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye swāhā/ drug bcas khyon bdun 'bul ba'i bdun bar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad zhi ba dang snod bcud thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes sbyar de bzhin du/ oṃ agna ye agna ye swāhā/ zhes dang / oṃ agna ye swāhā drug oṃ agna ye bdag gis sogs gong bzhin gyis mar de bzhin rdzas sngags 'og ma kun la rigs 'gre zhing / sngags so sor bsgyur/ badzra puṣṭa ye/ 'bras dmar po dang / sarba saṃ pa de/ zas mchog dang / sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ya til dang / badzra bi dza ya/ so ba dang / ma hā be ga ya/ nas dang / badzra ghasma ra ya/ gro dang / ma hā ba lā/ sran ma dang / badzra ā yuḥṣe/ dur wa dang / oṃ ā pra ti hā ta badzra swāhā/ zhes pas ku sha rnams 'bul/ slar yang gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la/ mar dgang blug gang thab tu phul la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/

de nas 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i khrod du thun mong ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang sogs bdag bskyed bzhin la yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim zhes dang / slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las sogs dbang lha spyan 'dren nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par sogs nas/ dbu brgyan bar/ tshig cung zad bsgyur ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed bzhin/ oṃ ku ru kulle hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i mthar agne lan bdun gyi mthar dī pyā dī pyā sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis sngar ltar byon zan phul/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin la rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ nī ri nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ bar/ oṃ ku ru kulle nī ri hūṃ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs chu bzhi dang / oṃ ku ru kulle puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes nyer mchod rol mo ghaṇḍe ra ṇi bcas/ oṃ ku ru kulle oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ brtse bas rjes chags sogs bstod pa rnams byas la/ oṃ ku ru kulle hriḥswāhā/ tshar gcig oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye swāhā/ bcu gcig gi rjes su mar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa ye bdag gi sogs gong bzhin/ de bzhin rdzas so so'i sngon du rje btsun ma'i sngags tshar re/ bar du rdzas sngags gang yin bsgyur mthar spel tshig sbyar ba'i rigs 'gre rang yin no/ /bcu cha'i sbyin sreg lta bu yin na me tog dmar po'am/ de ma 'byor na 'bras dmar po dang / mngar gsum gyi ril bu la grangs bzung ste khri phrag brgyad 'bul dgos pas nyin gsum pa'i dbang du btang nas nyin dang po cho ga tshar gcig la stong phrag gnyis re'i mtshams su 'bul tshan bcu gcig re byas pa tshar bcu'am dgu bar rdzas thams cad rje btsun ma'i sngags kho nas phul mthar spel tshig sbyar/

bcu par 'bul tshan dang po bzhin yin pas grangs 'dzin lugs ni pang du rdzas snod bzhag nas gong du bshad pa'i rdzas gang 'byor de g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis snod zhig tu blugs g.yon pas phreng bar grangs bzung stong phrag gnyis re song ba dang / thog mar gang yang mi brjod par thab nang pang thog tu rdzas bsags pa de phul/ de nas yam shing sogs 'bul/ bsgrub g.yog gis me rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir yam shing rnams rim gyis 'jug pa ma gtogs dus gcig la mi bsreg go /tshul des zhag gnyis pa la cho ga tshar gnyis la 'bul tshan gong bzhin/ zhag gsum pa la cho ga 'bul tshan bcas/ zhag dang po bzhin byas pas khri tsho brgyad 'gro'o/ /'bul tshan rdzogs pa dang / byon zan 'bul ba'i skabs ltar mar dgang blug gsum phul la sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya/ gtor ma dang po bsang sbyang byin brlab gong gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin/ rje btsun ma'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pas phul/ oṃ ku ru kulle oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ brtse bas rjes chags padma ra ga'i dog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu utpal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang /

/'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka te no pa tiṣṭha dri dho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su poṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan badzra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa lan gsum/ thal sbyar gyis/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces dang / oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul la gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa'i mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol dang / badzra muḥye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam ste/ thab kyi thal ba cung zad mtheb srin gyis blangs nas dpral bar thig le bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ thab tu mar dgang blugs gang phul la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur zhes brjod la/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams ji tsam 'byor pa gong bzhin phul/ mjug tu mar dgang blug gsum gyis gshegs skyems phul la/ gtor ma bsang sbyang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ mchod sbyin phyag rgya mthar se gol gtogs la/ oṃ agna ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā naṃ a dyaṃ nutpanna twod oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ yig brgya'i mthar ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/

/agne ye gatstsha zhes dang / spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de ye shes pa gshegs su gsol dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du 'grub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po/ /rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin/ /rnam par dag cing rgyud gcig la/ /skal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te/ /thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod paṇa bcings/ /lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug sgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing / sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces bsngo smon ci shes dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs bkra shis ci rigs bya'o/ /thal ba me ma shi ba'i bar du mi bsgul/ mthar legs par bsdus te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung chen por dor la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun ma nyid kyi sbyin sreg gi gzhung dang / der mi gsal ba rnams kyai rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge las cung zad kha bskangs nas mdor bsdus te nyams su blang bde bar ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa de nyid nag 'gros su bkod pa 'di ni sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blos gros kyis gdung nag zhabs drung erthe ne paṇḍita me sgan hu thog thu ngag dbang blo bzang 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i bzhed skong du sbyar ba'i dge bas bstan 'gror phan bde spel ba'i rgyur gyur cig
